entries.title: Surveying, Metrics Overhaul & Feature Corrections
entries.description: Added Client Surveying & Satisfaction module (36 total features). Restructured Metrics & Impact to lead with time savings, efficiency, and client satisfaction. Fixed PURL (Personal URL), E-Signature (native, no DocuSign), CarPlay (business command center), and Integrations Hub descriptions.

entries.title: Lead Lifecycle & MUM Portfolio Added
entries.description: Added Lead Lifecycle Management (9-stage pipeline, dual scoring, AI nurturing) and Mortgages Under Management Portfolio (refi detection, retention scoring, client portal). Total features now 35.

entries.title: Complete Feature Audit & Accuracy Update
entries.description: Expanded features section from 15 to 33 features covering all built capabilities. Corrected architecture stats from codebase audit: 42 AI agents, 3,934 API routes, 271 pages, 723 data models.

entries.title: Living Overview Page
entries.description: Overview page now auto-updates stats on every push and shows returning visitors what's new.

entries.title: E-Sign & Auth Completion
entries.description: Completed 7 unfinished features including eSign, authentication, calendar sync, SMS, transfers, and biometrics.

entries.title: Mobile Call Intelligence
entries.description: Added mobile call intelligence with 6 AI agents and Deepgram streaming for real-time transcription.
